skill.name: search-b2b-prospects
skill.description: Finds B2B people by title, function, seniority, country, company size and industry with the Leadsets search_people tool, and returns a ranked table that shows why each person matched. It plans the run against search limits and probes the filters first. Use when someone asks to search prospects, find people matching a persona, pull a list of VPs or heads of a function, or see who fits an ICP before enriching.
skill.summary: Find B2B prospects with Leadsets and see why each person matches your search filters.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell and reconnaissance alerts are false positives; the Leadsets search does send prospect criteria to a third-party service. The workflow can broaden filters without approval and does not specify safeguards against spreadsheet formulas in CSV exports. No evidence of malicious instructions or hidden data transfers was found.

remediation.issue: CSV exports lack spreadsheet formula protection for fields returned by Leadsets.
remediation.suggestion: Use a CSV serializer and neutralize formula-like text before export. Test that exported text stays inert in supported spreadsheet applications.

remediation.issue: An empty probe can trigger searches outside the user's original filters.
remediation.suggestion: Treat explicit filters as fixed. Show the proposed change and any record cost, then wait for approval before broadening the search.

remediation.issue: Search criteria are sent to the external Leadsets service.
remediation.suggestion: Use an approved Leadsets connection and submit only supported search fields. Do not send source documents or confidential notes.

semantic_findings.title: CSV export lacks spreadsheet formula protection
semantic_findings.description: The workflow exports text fields from search results without specifying formula protection. A spreadsheet may interpret those fields as formulas when the file is opened.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The CSV includes text from Leadsets, and the export instructions omit formula protection. No malicious record or vulnerable spreadsheet behavior was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Empty searches can broaden user-defined filters
semantic_findings.description: An empty probe triggers filter relaxation, which can include dropping industry or company size constraints. The workflow can collect out-of-scope contacts and spend records without approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly say to loosen filters after an empty probe and report the changes. They do not require user approval before the next probe.

content.value_statement: Finding prospects who fit a specific role and company profile takes time. This skill turns your criteria into a ranked Leadsets shortlist with reasons for each match.
actual_capabilities: Converts a plain-language persona into title, function, seniority, country, company size, and industry filters.
Checks remaining search records and tests the filters with a one-record probe before fetching more results.
Fetches results in pages, removes duplicate people, and ranks matches using available scores and reasons.
Filters for provider-labeled verified work emails on request and preserves email status labels in the results.
Returns a chat table or CSV with match reasons, email status counts, and search records used and remaining.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets account and a connected MCP server or a REST API key.
Result volume depends on available records, account quotas, and rate limits.
Does not enrich contacts, verify emails independently, or return phone numbers or home addresses.
Does not directly write to a CRM or send outreach.

use_cases.title: Build a Sales Shortlist

use_cases.title: Test a Buyer Persona
use_cases.description: Review a sample of people in a new market to see whether their titles and employers match your assumptions.

use_cases.title: Review Search Usage

prompt_templates.title: Find a Small Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 10 heads of sales at software companies in Canada. Show me why each person matched.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a simple search and review the matches in chat.

prompt_templates.title: Search by Company Size
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 25 marketing directors at UK fintech companies with 50 to 200 employees. Ask before relaxing any filter.
prompt_templates.scenario: Keep a prospect shortlist within a defined market segment.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by Work Email Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 30 heads of finance at US software companies. Include only people whose work emails are labeled verified by Leadsets. Show the check date when available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review existing verification labels without running enrichment.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quota-Aware Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 150 operations directors at US logistics companies with 200 to 1,000 employees. Check my quota, probe the filters, and remove duplicates across pages. Keep the results in chat and report records used and remaining.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan a search across multiple pages without exceeding available records.

best_practices: State the titles, countries, company sizes, and industries that must match.
Set a target count and ask for approval before changing any required filter.
Use an approved Leadsets connection and share exported contact data only with authorized recipients.
anti_patterns: Requesting a full list before checking the quota and reviewing the probe.
Treating catch-all or unknown email labels as verified.
Assuming the skill will send outreach or update a CRM.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need a Leadsets account and either a configured Leadsets MCP connection or a REST API key.

faq.question: Which filters can I combine?
faq.answer: You can combine title, function, seniority, country, company size, industry, and a verified work email filter.

faq.question: Does this skill verify emails?
faq.answer: No. It can filter by existing Leadsets verification labels, but it does not run verification or enrichment.

faq.question: Does the one-record probe use my quota?
faq.answer: A probe uses one search record if it returns a person. An empty probe uses a request but no search records.

faq.question: What happens if my quota is too low?
faq.answer: The skill checks the available records before searching. It lowers the target to fit the quota and reports when the window resets.

faq.question: How can I receive the results?
faq.answer: Results appear in a chat table by default. You can request a CSV instead.
